name: IntentQoS Early-Flow 14-Feature Canonical Schema
description: Transport-aware early-flow features computed over the first 32 packets of bidirectional flow metadata without payload inspection.

features.name: destination_port
features.description: Transport layer destination port (e.g. 443 for HTTPS/QUIC, 80 for HTTP, 50000+ for WebRTC).

features.name: flow_duration_ms
features.description: Elapsed duration between first observed packet and the 32nd packet (or timeout).

features.name: total_fwd_packets
features.description: Number of packets transmitted in forward (client-to-server) direction.

features.name: total_bwd_packets
features.description: Number of packets received in backward (server-to-client) direction.

features.name: total_fwd_bytes
features.description: Total cumulative bytes transmitted in forward direction.

features.name: total_bwd_bytes
features.description: Total cumulative bytes received in backward direction.

features.name: fwd_packet_len_mean
features.description: Mean IP packet length in forward direction.

features.name: fwd_packet_len_std
features.description: Standard deviation of IP packet lengths in forward direction.

features.name: bwd_packet_len_mean
features.description: Mean IP packet length in backward direction.

features.name: bwd_packet_len_std
features.description: Standard deviation of IP packet lengths in backward direction.

features.name: fwd_iat_mean_ms
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time between forward packets.

features.name: bwd_iat_mean_ms
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time between backward packets.

features.name: flow_bytes_per_sec
features.description: Early-window aggregate throughput in bytes per second.

features.name: flow_packets_per_sec
features.description: Early-window aggregate packet rate in packets per second.
